name: FOAWA Flight Scholarship - Advanced Level
notes: Ages 17-24, holds a pilot certificate, working toward commercial. All flight training must be done at St. Pete Air - funds are paid directly to them.
timing: Annual cycle. The 2026 deadline was 9 January, so the next is likely January 2027.

name: Bill Stroecker Commercial/Instrument Flight Training Scholarship
notes: Current AOPA membership, US resident. One application covers the named awards.
timing: Two windows a year. Autumn: 1 October to 30 December, decisions by 15 April. Spring: 1 April to 30 June, decisions by 15 September.

name: Breva Thrive Grant
focus: Entrepreneurs having a positive impact in an underrepresented community
notes: Open to any US small business that can show community impact. Must be legally registered and generating revenue. Prefers a year in business and businesses in low-income areas.

name: PAPA Flight Training Scholarship
notes: PAPA membership required. 18+, high school diploma or GED. Each award has its own criteria, visible only once logged in.
timing: Spring and autumn cycles. The spring 2026 window has closed. Watch for the autumn opening.

name: Richard McSpadden Scholarship for Advanced Pilots
notes: Current AOPA membership, US resident. One application covers the named awards.
timing: Two windows a year. Autumn: 1 October to 30 December, decisions by 15 April. Spring: 1 April to 30 June, decisions by 15 September.

name: OBAP LIFT Academy Scholarship
notes: Active OBAP membership required. Apply via the AwardSpring portal using the email on your membership. Two letters of recommendation, the primary one from an active OBAP member.
timing: Applications open through the AwardSpring portal once membership is active. Membership must be 3+ months old before applying.

name: Part Time Pilot Quarterly Scholarship
notes: Short application. $1,000 plus free ground school, awarded to multiple students.
timing: Awarded quarterly, so it can be reapplied for each cycle.

name: Center for Internet Security
notes: Not a funder. Publishes useful guidance on what SLCGP money may be spent on, and provides free services to public entities.

name: CFBAA Scholarship Programs (4 distinct)
notes: Five awards totalling $13,000. Application window closes 28 April. Requires a completed form and a 60-second video.

name: Florida Digital Service
notes: Where Florida's share of SLCGP is administered. Watch for subaward opportunities.
